parsed_json.up: Select distinct compound ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in human assays against the target Phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate 3-kinase catalytic subunit (CHEMBL3267). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join assays on assay_id, and join target_dictionary on tid. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL3267 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Require structures via an inner join to compound_structures on molregno. Sort by compound ChEMBL identifier.
